critic_transfer.scope: Fresh frozen pools excluded from property-head fitting and early stopping. Off pools are unique coordinates, not duplicated target requests; off hit diagnostics use their stored P50 request.

critic_ranking.scope: Fixed top-4/top-8 by predicted point distance, ties by original candidate ID. Only physically accepted rankable endpoints; no replacement of SCF failures or missing slots. DFT labels never rank or fit here. Does not change original whole-pool generation yields.

quantum_inputs.scope: Exact original SDF byte blocks; no coordinate re-serialization. Extract by byte offset/length to recover each original quantum-input SHA. Local cohort indices are scoped by arm; combined_input_index is global.

whole_pool_scope: Five fixed HOMO requests, one training seed. The 256 unique shared-off proposals are rescored at all five requests; those rescored records are not independent proposals. Frozen input reports are checksum-bound in publication_source_sha256.
evaluation_cost_scope: Reported component timers: raw generation plus scoring includes diagnostic fingerprint evaluation; terminal and B candidate timers exclude model loading; quantum queue timer includes its reported queue overhead.
